incident: participant-token cross-device identity contamination (pre-fix localStorage persistence)
why: Bot survey links carried pt=<30-day signed token> of the link minter. The old web build persisted it in localStorage forever, so every later visitor of a browser that had opened such a link answered as that user — for every identity-gated feature (surveys, trial tasks, check-ins, endings, achievements). Evidence: 14 distinct device fingerprints across different carrier IPs under user_id=1 between 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-17; the account owner reports filling none of them.
guard: WHERE user_id = 1 / participant_hash = 'user_1' AND explicit id lists or date windows only

kept.reason: Completed before the token mechanism shipped (commit 36cc720, 2026-08-24), or a single early profile fill outside any burst.

leftForOwnerDecision.taskRunsKept: 5 runs before 2026-10-15 (2 on 2026-09-09, 3 completed on 2026-10-14) — plausibly the owner's own launch tests.
leftForOwnerDecision.achievementsKept: first_survey + trial_first_clear (2026-10-14T15:34) — no matching completion on that date, likely legacy or owner testing.
leftForOwnerDecision.coinCheckins: 2 rows (2026-10-15, 2026-10-16) and coin balance 30 / total_earned 30 from those check-ins — ledger left append-only, not rewritten.
leftForOwnerDecision.profileShare: 1 profile_shares row created and revoked in the same second (2026-10-15T16:09), never publicly exposed.

restore: Responses: UPDATE survey_responses SET user_id = 1, participant_hash = 'user_1' WHERE id IN (…). Task runs: UPDATE task_runs SET user_id = 1, participant_hash = 'user_1' WHERE id IN (…). Deleted achievements/endings: rows are listed above and can be re-inserted (codes / surveyId+resultType, timestamps in the release doc).
